#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Replace hardcoded Tailwind slate/white colors with MindVault design tokens."""

import re

FILE = "/Users/x/Projects/mindvault/frontend/src/routes/search/+page.svelte"

# Ordered replacements — more specific patterns first to avoid partial matches.
REPLACEMENTS = [
    # bg with opacity variants \(must come before bare bg-slate-900\)
    \("bg-slate-900/40", "bg-[rgb\(var\(--mv-panel\)\)]/40"\),
    \("bg-slate-900/50", "bg-[rgb\(var\(--mv-panel\)\)]/50"\),
    \("bg-slate-900/60", "bg-[rgb\(var\(--mv-panel\)\)]/60"\),
    \("bg-slate-900/80", "bg-[rgb\(var\(--mv-panel\)\)]/80"\),
    \("bg-slate-900/20", "bg-[rgb\(var\(--mv-panel\)\)]/20"\),
    # bg-slate-800/40 \(used in empty state suggestion buttons\)
    \("bg-slate-800/40", "bg-[rgb\(var\(--mv-panel-strong\)\)]/40"\),
    # hover variants \(must come before bare bg-slate-700 / bg-slate-800\)
    \("hover:bg-slate-700", "hover:bg-[rgb\(var\(--mv-panel-strong\)\)]/80"\),
    \("hover:bg-slate-800", "hover:bg-[rgb\(var\(--mv-panel-strong\)\)]"\),
    # bare bg
    \("bg-slate-900", "bg-[rgb\(var\(--mv-panel\)\)]"\),
    \("bg-slate-800", "bg-[rgb\(var\(--mv-panel-strong\)\)]"\),
    \("bg-slate-700", "bg-[rgb\(var\(--mv-panel-strong\)\)]/80"\),
    # border variants — more specific first
    \("border-slate-900", "border-[rgb\(var\(--mv-border\)\)]"\),
    \("border-slate-800", "border-[rgb\(var\(--mv-border\)\)]"\),
    \("border-slate-700", "border-[rgb\(var\(--mv-border\)\)]"\),
    \("border-slate-600", "border-[rgb\(var\(--mv-border\)\)]"\),
    \("hover:border-slate-700", "hover:border-[rgb\(var\(--mv-border\)\)]"\),
    # text
    \("text-white", "text-[rgb\(var\(--mv-text\)\)]"\),
    \("text-slate-400", "text-[rgb\(var\(--mv-muted\)\)]"\),
    \("text-slate-500", "text-[rgb\(var\(--mv-muted\)\)]/60"\),
    \("text-slate-300", "text-[rgb\(var\(--mv-muted\)\)]"\),
    \("text-slate-200", "text-[rgb\(var\(--mv-muted\)\)]"\),
    \("text-slate-600", "text-[rgb\(var\(--mv-muted\)\)]/40"\),
    \("hover:text-white", "hover:text-[rgb\(var\(--mv-text\)\)]"\),
    \("hover:text-slate-300", "hover:text-[rgb\(var\(--mv-muted\)\)]"\),
    # placeholder
    \("placeholder-slate-500", "placeholder-[rgb\(var\(--mv-muted\)\)]/60"\),
]

with open\(FILE, "r"\) as f:
    content = f.read\(\)

for old, new in REPLACEMENTS:
    content = content.replace\(old, new\)

with open\(FILE, "w"\) as f:
    f.write\(content\)

# Verify no slate remnants remain \(except semantic colors like border-slate-600 in checkboxes\)
remaining = re.findall\(r'\(?:bg|text|border|placeholder|hover:bg|hover:text|hover:border\)-slate-\\d+\(?:/\\d+\)?', content\)
if remaining:
    print\(f"WARNING: {len\(remaining\)} slate references still present:"\)
    for r in sorted\(set\(remaining\)\):
        count = remaining.count\(r\)
        print\(f"  {r} \({count}x\)"\)
else:
    print\("All slate references replaced successfully."\)

print\("\\nDone. File written."\)
PYEOF)
